## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest coherent solution.

## Compatibility

- [ ] Public props, events, plugin installation, and CSS imports remain compatible with Vue 2.7.
- [ ] Any intentional breaking change is targeted at the planned `2.x` line and documented.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run build:demo`
- [ ] `npm run test:package`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when browser or layout behavior changed

## Visual evidence

Add before/after screenshots or a recording for layout and interaction changes.
